evidence.r1: Light and dark: transport, volume and playlist actions use glass; the queue is solid and album text sits directly on artwork.
evidence.r2: Light and dark: the playlist menu replaces Save Queue, with a flat focused row rather than nested glass.
evidence.r3: Light and dark: three glass surfaces serve transport, volume and queue-saving actions.
evidence.r4: Light and dark: transport, volume and playlist menu share a consistent frosted treatment.
evidence.r5: Light and dark: no separate clear-glass treatment is visible on the playback controls.
evidence.r6: Light and dark: playback and queue-action controls use neutral backgrounds without a saturated tint.
evidence.r7: Light: ice texture and colour remain softened within the transport, volume and playlist surfaces.
evidence.r8: Light and dark: transport, volume and Save Queue are capsules, while the playlist menu has fixed rounded corners.
evidence.r9: Light and dark playlist menus: the focused Late Desk pill has tighter end arcs than the outer menu corner minus its narrow inset.
evidence.r10: Light and dark: floating playback and queue controls use capsule silhouettes and the focused menu row is capsule-shaped.
evidence.r11: Light and dark: transport items share a bar, volume is separate, and queue actions occupy their own group.
evidence.r12: Light and dark: transport has icon buttons and readouts, while the playlist menu contains text actions without an independent icon button.
evidence.r13: Light and dark: material surrounds the complete playback or queue control rather than being applied separately to its inner labels.
evidence.r14: Light and dark: transport items form one continuous surface and volume sits deliberately apart.
evidence.r15: Light and dark: no scroll-edge effect is visible around the bottom transport or queue region.
evidence.r16: Light and dark: ice veins and cracks provide a varied backdrop under every glass surface.
evidence.r17: Light and dark resting views: track text and queue rows remain clear of the transport, volume and Save Queue controls.
evidence.r18: Light and dark: playback time labels and playlist names stay strongly separated from their pale or charcoal surfaces.
evidence.r19: Reduced light: Save Queue text drops toward the bottom edge of its capsule, and increased-contrast and reduced-motion states are unshown.
evidence.r20: Light and dark: album artwork reaches every window edge under the floating playback controls.
evidence.r21: Light and dark: text columns and queue end above or beside the bottom controls while artwork continues behind the inset queue.
evidence.r22: Light and dark: the Playing Next sheet uses a solid custom-looking background with a visible enclosing edge.
evidence.r23: Light and dark playlist endpoints do not show the opening transition or pointer glow and flex.
evidence.r24: Light and dark: floating control symbols and labels are monochrome; the small orange playing indicator remains in the track list.
evidence.r25: Light and dark: neutral playback and playlist labels avoid the blue-grey hues of the ice artwork.
